tick_cost.evidence: Measure attributed idle/busy component timing in bounded routines and rerun a maximum sample. Extended-time behaviour stays inferred.
tick_cost.establishes: Measure attributed idle/busy component timing in bounded routines and rerun a maximum sample. Extended-time behaviour stays inferred.

long_stall.evidence: Measure frame/log windows around ordinary jobs and transitions and attribute stalls. Unobserved longer sessions stay inferred.
long_stall.establishes: Measure frame/log windows around ordinary jobs and transitions and attribute stalls. Unobserved longer sessions stay inferred.

latency.evidence: Measure order click to visible uptake on the test machine and record waiting state. Other machines stay inferred.
latency.establishes: Measure order click to visible uptake on the test machine and record waiting state. Other machines stay inferred.

memory.evidence: Measure retained objects/textures across bounded repeated contacts, extractions, cleanup and reload cycles. A 30-day trend remains inferred.
memory.establishes: Measure retained objects/textures across bounded repeated contacts, extractions, cleanup and reload cycles. A 30-day trend remains inferred.

load_time.evidence: Measure added time for three comparable cold existing-save loads in the canonical supported context. Other lists stay inferred.
load_time.establishes: Measure added time for three comparable cold existing-save loads in the canonical supported context. Other lists stay inferred.

save_size.evidence: Measure serialised payload size before and after bounded growing/expiry/archive/repeat cycles. Extended-time growth remains inferred.
save_size.establishes: Measure serialised payload size before and after bounded growing/expiry/archive/repeat cycles. Extended-time growth remains inferred.

save_compat.evidence: Use a real prior save and saved intermediate states. Document removal losses. Executed removal remains an extended check when requested.

load_order.evidence: Check source/deployed composition and actual effects on the canonical supported list. External compatibility is extended when requested.

log.evidence: Lossless log tap across each scene with missing/capped-log controls and attributable warnings/errors.

mod_settings.evidence: Every major setting maps to a real consumer, before/mid-state variants, reset, labels and independently verified recovery.

multiplayer.evidence: Apply the inherited no-support standing ruling. No multiplayer work or promise is introduced.

art.evidence: Full shipped manifest and authored exceptions, dimensions/facings/human scale, actual in-game captures and owed owner review.

reads_as.evidence: Blind reader distinguishes visible states at ordinary play zoom across the finite manifested facings/states.

clickable.evidence: Click the drawn oversized giant outside its base cell in stages one/five and relevant facings.

order_taken.evidence: Capture immediate order uptake and actual waiting/job state for extraction, treatment, bills and vat start across their own scenes.

motion.evidence: Sequence captures across actual state/motion changes. Owner attends Dwommo live movement.

text.evidence: Read normal archive, seeker, warnings, settings, ledger and return UI in English for plain spoiler-free labels/tooltips.

dlc.evidence: All DLC assumed under the inherited floor. Inspect existing guards as data with no new DLC compatibility/degraded-mode work.

worldgen.evidence: Apply the inherited no-generation ruling. Inspect existing rarity, road and authored-biome defs read-only and use an already-existing supported world. No generation run or generation guarantee is added.

biome_scope.evidence: Support follows authored biome/tag/framework contracts. Zero generated tiles is allowed. Existing shipped legacy defs retain scoped checks.

flight.evidence: Read fields/frame data offline. Schedule actual Dwommo movement only with the owner attending under the existing ruling.

naming.evidence: Check mandrake.rm.biomes composed identity, member metadata and RM_/RUT_ defs against project naming rules.

test_isolation.evidence: Use minimal composed dependency closure then canonical supported list and campaign contexts. Verify exact durable recovery and independent teardown readback.
